ambient_events: Water slaps the pilings under the boards and draws back.
A cleat sits empty at the jetty's edge, rope-scarred and waiting.
Out on the black water, something large and unlit holds its position.
The beam from the tower crosses the boards, and every rail on the jetty picks it up at once.
description: Boards, salt-grey and slick, running north over open water on a double row of piles. The rail down both flanks is cold enough to take the skin off a wet hand. From here the tower at the end stops looking like a lighthouse: the waist is wrong, and nothing built for a keeper has ribs.
name: Basin Jetty
